programmes.d: A frustrated old maid determines to get herself a man, even at the cost of murder.
The head of a buffalo-hunting party is unwilling to tell Matt what he knows about the murders of two of his skinners.
Kathleen Nolan guest stars as a widow who falls in love with a wounded prisoner of Matt Dillon at a remote way station.
A man claims he can identify a murderer just to get attention.
Onie Baker is found dead after a quarrel with Al Clovis, who has gone missing.
A group of girls, prospecting for rich gold miners to marry, get involved with an unscrupulous wagon master.
Matt Dillon, the victim of a frame-up, is arrested on a charge of murdering a prisoner in his custody
A poverty-stricken woman and her son suffer the symptoms of scurvy and Doc Adams is almost helpless to do anything about it.
A new doctor faces the suspicion and mistrust of many of the townspeople when he fills in for the absent Doc Adams.
A bank robber murders his wife and frames Tobeel for the crime.
An old friend's brother attempts to 'save' Kitty from life as a saloonkeeper.
Marshal Matt Dillon faces the resentment of an entire town when he reopens a 12- year-old murder case.
The father of a rag-tag family of seven offers to sell his teenaged daughter to Marshal Dillon as a wife.
Matt Dillon tries to bring a man to justice despite the onslaughts of an almost maniacal man wishing to exact his own revenge.
After he is saved from hanging, a drifterplots revenge against the men who tried to lynch him.
Matt seeks evidence to convict a poker dealer of murdering a gambler.
A coffin at a funeral is found to be filled with rocks.
A ranch hand is accused of stealing a horse by his former boss.
Matt hunts down the Indians who are killing settlers.
Festus Haggen, left in charge of the Dodge City jail, learns his prisoners are his cousin and two old friends.
A dishonest gambler uses a mentally challenged man in a plot against Matt.
A retired Army officer asks Matt to appoint him deputy.
A former saloon girl's upcoming marriage is jeopardized by her old boyfriend.
After being duped into helping to shoot and kill an outlaw, Kitty finds herself pursued by the outlaw's brother.
Private detectives use Kitty and the daughter of an outlaw as lures to trap the girl's fugitive father.
Matt must find out who sent a supposed professional killer to Dodge and why.
A woman is torn between the man she loves and the one her father picked for her.

Malt Dillon's arrest of a dirt farmer for horse stealing puts him on the trail of a man suspected of having framed the farmer.
Matt tries to bring a killer to Wichita on a stagecoach carrying a woman, a preacher and a huge shipment of gold.
Matt suspects the new saloon girl of being affiliated with a crooked gambler.
Dodge City merchants celebrate the end of a round-up and unite against any acts of violence.
A man gets a job, unaware that his boss is trying to make a move on his wife.
A crafty journalist bets that a greenhorn can pose as a hardened gunman in Dodge City for two weeks and not get killed.
Marshal Matt Dillon is suspected of murdering an unarmed bank robber he sent to prison five years before.
An Indian causes gold fever to break out in Dodge City when he pays for the funeral of a slain friend with a 350 gold piece.
